_comment: All signal thresholds live here. Edit and push; the daily workflow (or a manual run) recomputes signals.json and the dashboard.

mnav._both_overheated_comment: when MSTR and ASST are both overheated, sell both and hold BTC (overrides peg actions)

valuation._comment: Zones for the 'who's cheap vs expensive' module. CHEAP: diluted mNAV < cheap_below_mnav. OVERVALUED: mNAV >= mnav.overheated_min_mnav OR 1y percentile >= mnav.overheated_percentile. FAIR: otherwise, with percentile <= fair_max_percentile (median). RICH: between the median and OVERVALUED.

dip._comment: Dip = BTC down >= btc_drop_pct over the last lookback_days trading days. Target = whichever of MSTR/ASST had the larger % drop in diluted mNAV over the same window (got cheaper vs its own bitcoin); tie (within tie_tolerance) broken by the larger price drop.

big_moves._comment: absolute daily close-to-close % move that counts as a Big Move

ev_snapshot._comment: Inputs for the CURRENT enterprise-value mNAV (snapshot only). EV mNAV = (price x basic shares + debt + preferred notional - cash) / (BTC held x BTC price). ASST inputs are auto-read from Strive's latest weekly 8-K table (cash, STRC held, SATA & SATS counts at $100 stated amount); MSTR inputs below must be updated by hand from strategy.com.

MSTR.source: https://www.strategy.com/ (dashboard snapshot 10/26/2026 11:51 AM ET: mkt cap $60,501M at $143.25, debt $6,714M, pref $13,347M, USD Reserve $4,833M, cash $242M)

ASST.debt_note: Strive's weekly table lists no debt line; debt assumed 0 (verify in 10-Q).

prediction_markets._comment: Events to track. Polymarket by event slug (polymarket.com/event/<slug>), Kalshi by event ticker. Dead/closed events are skipped and shown as errors.

kalshi.label: How high will BTC get in 2026
How low will BTC get in 2026
Will the CLARITY Act become law (by date)

odds_jumps._comment: Odds Jumps module: flag tracked prediction markets whose Yes probability moved >= jump_24h_pts in one day or >= jump_7d_pts over 7 days, within the last window_days.
